items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Deepens Korea AI Ecosystem with SK Group $500B+ Factories, NAVER Expansion and SNU AI Technology Center
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 深化韓國 AI 生態：SK Group 逾5000億美元工廠、NAVER 擴建與首爾大學 AI 技術中心
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced a $500-billion-plus partnership with SK Group spanning AI factories and next-generation memory, including a 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory to be built by SK Telecom (powered by SK hynix HBM, targeted 2027) plus long-term HBM co-development. Separately with NAVER and Brookfield, NVIDIA plans to expand a multi-tenant DSX AI factory to 200 megawatts by 2028 and invest $1 billion in NAVER. On 25 July NVIDIA introduced the NVIDIA AI Technology Center at Seoul National University for joint research on physical AI, foundation models, talent development and infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布與 SK Group 超過5000億美元夥伴關係，涵蓋 AI 工廠與下一代記憶體，包括 SK Telecom 建造的2吉瓦 NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI 工廠（由 SK hynix HBM 供電，目標2027年）及長期 HBM 共同開發。另與 NAVER、Brookfield 計畫將多租戶 DSX AI 工廠擴至2028年200兆瓦，並投資 NAVER 10億美元。7月25日 NVIDIA 介紹於首爾大學設立 NVIDIA AI Technology Center，聚焦物理 AI、基礎模型、人才培育與基礎設施聯合研究。
items_flat.analysis_en: These coordinated deals highlight intensifying sovereign AI infrastructure competition in Asia and NVIDIA’s full-stack lock-in strategy across compute, memory and talent. Execution timelines to 2027-2028 and the precise funding structures remain key uncertainties amid global supply constraints.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些協調協議凸顯亞洲主權 AI 基礎設施競爭加劇，以及 NVIDIA 在運算、記憶體與人才上的全棧鎖定策略。2027-2028年執行時程與精確資金結構，在全球供應限制下仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: When I left this morning, I was just Jensen. Next time I come back, call me K-Jensen. Korea isn't just an NVIDIA partner anymore. It's where the next wave of AI gets built and SNU is at the center of it.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今早離開時我只是 Jensen。下次回來叫我 K-Jensen。韓國不再只是 NVIDIA 的夥伴，而是下一波 AI 建設的中心，首爾大學位居核心。

items_flat.title_en: Demis Hassabis Affirms Support for Strong Open AI Ecosystem
items_flat.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 重申支持強大開放 AI 生態系
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis posted on X that a strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. He highlighted DeepMind’s contributions including Jax, Transformers, AlphaFold and Gemma models (Gemma 4 models downloaded more than 300 million times; the full Gemma series more than 900 million times). The post came in the context of NVIDIA’s letter defending open models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 執行長 Demis Hassabis 在 X 發文表示，強大且安全的開放生態系對世界從 AI 受益至關重要。他強調 DeepMind 的貢獻包括 Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold 與 Gemma 模型（Gemma 4 模型下載量逾3億次；整個 Gemma 系列逾9億次）。此文回應 NVIDIA 捍衛開放模型的公開信。
items_flat.analysis_en: This restates Google’s consistent open-source posture amid the open-versus-closed policy debate. Uncertainty remains on how regulators will weigh open-model contributions against proprietary frontier systems in future rules.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉重申 Google 一貫的開源立場，正值開放與封閉政策辯論升溫。監管機構未來如何權衡開放模型貢獻與專有前沿系統，仍存不確定性。
items_flat.quote: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times.
items_flat.quote_zh: 強大且安全的開放生態系對世界從 AI 受益至關重要。我們一直大力支持並貢獻開源與科學，從 Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold 到 Gemma 開放模型，後者現已下載逾3億次。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Provides Update on Hugging Face Security Incident Review
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 Hugging Face 安全事件審查進度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI stated it recognizes questions and speculative details circulating about the Hugging Face incident, calling it an unprecedented event that marks an important moment for AI safety. The company is conducting a thorough review with external advisors and oversight from its Safety and Security Committee, and plans to publish a technical report of its learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示理解外界對 Hugging Face 事件的疑問與揣測細節，稱此為前所未有的事件，並標誌 AI 安全的重要時刻。公司正與外部顧問及安全與保安委員會監督下進行徹底審查，並計畫於未來數週發布技術報告分享學習成果。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a procedural update rather than new technical disclosure. The forthcoming report will be the key test of how much concrete containment and alignment insight the industry gains from the incident.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為程序性更新而非新技術揭露。即將發布的報告將是產業從此事件中能獲得多少具體遏制與對齊洞察的關鍵考驗。
items_flat.quote: We recognize there are a lot of questions and speculative details circulating related to the Hugging Face incident. This is an unprecedented incident, and we think it marks an important moment for AI safety. We are still conducting a thorough review along with external advisors and with oversight from our Safety and Security Committee. Once the review is complete, we plan to publish a technical report of our learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們理解外界對 Hugging Face 事件有許多疑問與揣測細節。這是前所未有的事件，我們認為它標誌 AI 安全的重要時刻。我們仍與外部顧問並在安全與保安委員會監督下進行徹底審查。審查完成後，我們計畫於未來數週發布技術報告分享學習成果。

Demis Hassabis reaffirmed Google DeepMind’s support for a strong open ecosystem, citing Gemma’s 900M+ downloads.
